notes: ALL 9 RUNS FAILED ON THE ENVIRONMENT, NOT THE ENGINE. Starting Nov 7 ~20:48 UTC, exec-spawned processes cannot write files (EPERM: operation not permitted, write). Every render died in ~1 s at the validate stage on its first file write (page.html), exit 5, before Chromium launched. The runner retried each render 4 times over ~95 s and all attempts failed the same way. No v2 wall time, sha, or video exists. The engine changes themselves are verified at small scale (12-24 frame renders, determinism, --set, compact scenes) in the run report. Re-run this benchmark when exec writes work again: python3 benchmark/run-benchmark.py --profiles draft,final,final-max --tag v2. Also recorded in AGENTS.md: exec writes to workspace files fail, file tools work, /tmp writes work for the shell. The v1 run videos in benchmark/runs/ were deleted by the failed v2 attempts (the CLI removes video.mp4 from the out dir on a failed render); v1 shas survive in benchmark/results-2026-11-07.json.
